activity_summary: You were still on the palace side of the green, and you took the walk. The button stayed lost, and Heminges kept Kemp's story for the inn down the river, not for this grass and not for the Feathers. Phillips allowed no song. Two borrowed cloaks stayed uncounted until daylight. You, Heminges, and Bryan have the one bed. This is the one Sunday, and the prayer is at the inn.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Started the walk, refused a dark count, and named the one Sunday.

entities.name: John Heminges
entities.context: Kept the story for the downriver inn, and named the bed.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Held the story, and agreed a green is not an inn.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Refused a song on the grass and a verse on the stair.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Took Sam off the floor and left the night's end as a rustle, a cough, and a chair.

entities.name: Sam Latchet
entities.context: Walked, and did not go back to the rushes.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Kept the yeoman from being given a speech, and took the short green.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Beside them, and did not sing.

entities.name: Thomas Pope
entities.context: Already on the stair, and not collected.

facets.activity: Took the walk back to the inn

quotes.speaker: john_heminges
quotes.text: Until the inn, when we are down the river.

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: A green is not an inn.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: And no song on the grass.
